sloka: अतुलं च गता हर्षं प्रहर्षेण च जानकी ।नेत्राभ्यां वक्रपक्ष्मभ्यां मुमोचानन्दजं जलम् ।। ५.३५.८५।।।।
transliteration: atulaṁ ca gatā harṣaṁ praharṣeṇa ca jānakī ।netrābhyāṁ vakrapakṣmabhyāṁ mumocānandajaṁ jalam ।। 5.35.85।।।।

translations.english: Janaki experienced immeasurable happiness and shed tears of joy through her curved eyes.
